gui.vtm.title: Vampire Sheet
gui.vtm.mortal: You are mortal. The Blood has not claimed you.
message.vtm.no_blood: There is nothing to drink here.
message.vtm.stain: Your Beast stirs. You feel a stain on your soul.
commands.vtm.info: %s: %s, clan %s, generation %s, blood potency %s, blood %s, humanity %s, stains %s, xp %s
clan.vtm.banu_haqim.desc: Assamite judges and assassins who weigh the sins of the Kindred.
clan.vtm.banu_haqim.bane: Blood thirst: tasting vampiric vitae awakens a craving that is hard to refuse.
clan.vtm.brujah.desc: Passionate rebels and idealists, quick to fight for a cause.
clan.vtm.brujah.bane: Violent temper: you frenzy into rage more easily.
clan.vtm.gangrel.desc: Wanderers and survivors who feel the Beast closest to the surface.
clan.vtm.gangrel.bane: Bestial features: each frenzy leaves a lasting animal trait.
clan.vtm.hecata.desc: Keepers of death, bound in a family of necromancers.
clan.vtm.hecata.bane: Painful kiss: your feeding is unpleasant for mortals.
clan.vtm.lasombra.desc: Dark aristocrats who command shadow and ambition alike.
clan.vtm.lasombra.bane: Distorted image: mirrors and cameras do not show you faithfully.
clan.vtm.malkavian.desc: Seers whose madness is a window onto hidden truths.
clan.vtm.malkavian.bane: Fractured perspective: a permanent derangement colours your thoughts.
clan.vtm.ministry.desc: Serpent-priests who sell temptation and freedom.
clan.vtm.ministry.bane: Aversion to light: sunlight burns you twice as hard.
clan.vtm.nosferatu.desc: Horrors in the dark who hold the Camarilla's deepest secrets.
clan.vtm.nosferatu.bane: Repulsive: your hideous visage shatters any attempt at a normal life.
clan.vtm.ravnos.desc: Nomadic illusionists who live by their wits and their road.
clan.vtm.ravnos.bane: Doomed: a curse of wandering follows you; you cannot rest easily in one place.
clan.vtm.salubri.desc: Healers hunted for their third eye and their gift of mercy.
clan.vtm.salubri.bane: Hunted: your blood is coveted, and the third eye marks you.
clan.vtm.toreador.desc: Artists and aesthetes who chase beauty and the perfect moment.
clan.vtm.toreador.bane: Aesthetic fixation: ugliness and squalor dull your focus.
clan.vtm.tremere.desc: Warlock-scholars who forged their blood into a weapon.
clan.vtm.tremere.bane: Stunted bloodline: your blood is hard to share and harder to pass on.
clan.vtm.tzimisce.desc: Fiends of the old world who sculpt flesh and own their domain.
clan.vtm.tzimisce.bane: Grounded: you are tethered to your home soil and suffer without it.
clan.vtm.ventrue.desc: Born leaders of Kindred society, rulers of the powerful.
clan.vtm.ventrue.bane: Rarefied tastes: you can feed only on a specific kind of mortal.
clan.vtm.caitiff.desc: Clanless Kindred with no sire to teach them, outcasts everywhere.
clan.vtm.caitiff.bane: Clanless: every discipline is learned at the out-of-clan price.
clan.vtm.thin_blood.desc: Children of the thinning blood, barely vampires at all.
clan.vtm.thin_blood.bane: Thin: your blood is weak, and your gifts are limited to Thin-Blood Alchemy.
power.vtm.sense_the_beast.desc: Reveals every living creature within 24 blocks for a few seconds.
power.vtm.feral_whispers.desc: Tames wild wolves, cats and other tameable animals within 10 blocks.
power.vtm.quell_the_beast.desc: Cleanses harmful effects and lifts one stain from your soul.
power.vtm.summon_pack.desc: Calls three tame wolves to fight for you for a minute.
power.vtm.drawing_out_the_beast.desc: Hostile creatures nearby are gripped by primal fear: they weaken, slow and stop hunting you.
power.vtm.sense_the_unseen.desc: Strips invisibility from everything within 32 blocks and makes it glow.
power.vtm.premonition.desc: Foresight shields you with absorption hearts and good luck.
power.vtm.scry_the_soul.desc: Look into a creature or player to read their health, nature and clan.
power.vtm.share_the_senses.desc: Night vision, and every living thing within 48 blocks glows.
power.vtm.blood_bolt.desc: Hurls a bolt of corrosive vitae at the creature you are looking at.
power.vtm.extinguish_vitae.desc: Boils the blood of a target; the undead and vampires take double damage.
power.vtm.blood_of_potency.desc: Temporarily deepens your blood: Strength II and Resistance for a minute.
power.vtm.scorpions_touch.desc: Your touch spoils a victim's blood: Wither and Weakness.
power.vtm.theft_of_vitae.desc: Rip blood from a target at range and drink it. Drains vampires of their vitae.
power.vtm.cats_grace.desc: Passive: +5% movement speed per Celerity dot.
power.vtm.rapid_reflexes.desc: Haste II and Jump Boost for 30 seconds.
power.vtm.blink.desc: Vanish and reappear up to 10 blocks ahead.
power.vtm.traversal.desc: Speed IV, Jump Boost III and slow falling for 10 seconds.
power.vtm.cloud_memory.desc: A creature forgets you and will not hunt you for 20 seconds.
power.vtm.compel.desc: Command a creature to stand still and ignore you.
power.vtm.mesmerize.desc: Turn a creature against the nearest other mob.
power.vtm.mass_compel.desc: Every creature within 10 blocks is stilled and loses interest in you.
power.vtm.absolute_command.desc: Villagers give you the best prices; other creatures are calmed for a minute and empowered.
power.vtm.resilience.desc: Passive: armor, toughness and knockback resistance per Fortitude dot.
power.vtm.defy_bane.desc: Fire resistance for 90 seconds; sunlight cannot burn you.
power.vtm.fortify_the_inner_facade.desc: Six absorption hearts and Resistance II.
power.vtm.unseen_passage.desc: Invisibility for 45 seconds; anything hunting you loses the trail.
power.vtm.ghost_walk.desc: Creatures cannot target you for 30 seconds, and you move faster.
power.vtm.mask_of_a_thousand_faces.desc: Invisible and unnoticed by all creatures for a minute.
power.vtm.vanish.desc: Unseen and untargetable for two minutes, with a burst of speed.
power.vtm.oblivions_sight.desc: Night vision, and the undead and vampires within 32 blocks glow.
power.vtm.shadow_cast.desc: Smothers nearby creatures in darkness: blinded, slowed and distracted.
power.vtm.arms_of_the_abyss.desc: Shadowy limbs drag everything within 10 blocks toward you.
power.vtm.withering.desc: Rots a target with Wither II.
power.vtm.necrotic_plague.desc: A wave of decay: everything within 6 blocks withers, weakens and slows.
power.vtm.lethal_body.desc: Passive: more melee damage and knockback per Potence dot.
power.vtm.soaring_leap.desc: Leap far in the direction you are facing and land softly.
power.vtm.brutal_strike.desc: A crushing blow to everything in front of you.
power.vtm.earthshock.desc: Slam the ground: everything within 7 blocks is hurt, thrown and slowed.
power.vtm.awe.desc: Mortals adore you: Hero of the Village for three minutes.
power.vtm.daunt.desc: Nearby creatures are cowed: weakened, slowed and unwilling to attack.
power.vtm.entrancement.desc: Animals within 12 blocks fall under your spell: tamed, or driven into a loving mood.
power.vtm.dread_gaze.desc: Your stare cripples a target: weakness, slowness and blindness.
power.vtm.majesty.desc: An unbearable presence: Resistance III and every creature nearby stands down.
power.vtm.weight_of_the_feather.desc: Slow falling and Jump Boost II for a minute.
power.vtm.feral_weapons.desc: Claws and fangs: Strength and Haste II for 45 seconds.
power.vtm.earth_meld.desc: Sink into the earth: nearly invulnerable, regenerating and unseen, but unable to move for 10 seconds.
power.vtm.shapechange.desc: Take the beast's form: Speed II, Jump Boost II, Strength II and night vision.
power.vtm.far_reach.desc: Telekinetically pull every dropped item within 12 blocks to you.
power.vtm.catalyze.desc: An alchemical stimulant: Haste III and Strength for 40 seconds.
power.vtm.wake_with_evenings_fire.desc: Fire resistance for 90 seconds, letting you walk in daylight.
power.vtm.prismatic.desc: All the alchemy at once: Resistance II, Speed II and Strength II for 20 seconds.
gui.vtm.no_powers: Learn a discipline to unlock its powers.
message.vtm.power_locked: You have not mastered that power.
message.vtm.power_fizzled: The power fizzles: no valid target.
message.vtm.no_power_selected: No power selected. Cycle with Z / X.
